entries.prompt: Fresh original production creature design for ZERO-SUM OMEN, a richly inked coloured-manga bureaucratic folk-fantasy RPG. One DEBT HOUND, a mechanical debt-collection construct, full body all FOUR legs/paws and tail visible, genuinely transparent background. Clearly canine bloodhound silhouette with long downturned metal ears, narrow articulated black/brass body, sturdy four stamp-pad paws, low tracking stance facingLEFT. Distinctive functional design rather than generic robotdog: head shaped like a hinged ceramic ledger seal over a mechanical muzzle, paired ear plates resemble folded bookkeeping covers, exposed abacus-spine rails along shoulders, one empty smoked-glass confiscation chamber protected in a brass ribcage beneath the torso, little blank paper receipts clamped on back, short cable tail, pragmatic worn rivets/ratchets. Compact machine with memorable silhouette, intentional hierarchy of fine mechanical detail at head and jar, broad matte dark body planes. Orange status slit but NO text, digits, symbols, neon effects or scenery. Precise variable-weight ink lines, spotted blacks, selective engraved hatching, hard two-tone shadows, aged brass/rust/dark ceramic, one warm rim; polished original concept, no photo materials/3Dgloss. It is a construct, not a real animal: no flesh, gore, fangs or demon decoration. Four anatomically and mechanically readable limbs, no duplicated feet. The floating wheel will be rendered separately in the game.
